## What it was for
<!-- The experiment and what it was meant to do. One or two lines. -->

## What happened
<!-- How it broke, stalled, or fell short. Observed behavior, not theory. -->

## Receipts
<!-- Required. Show what happened — logs, screenshots, command output, stack traces, failing
     test runs. Don't just describe the failure; paste the evidence of it. -->

## Why
<!-- Root cause, if known. If you genuinely don't know, write "reason not captured."
     Do not invent a plausible one. -->

## What we learned
<!-- The finding. This is the part worth keeping. -->

## Disposition
<!-- Abandoned / revising / re-filed as a new experiment. -->
